Used to make diminutive forms of words, including personal names. When added to personal names, the name is normally truncated, typically down to a single syllable consisting of a consonant + vowel.

Calque of translingual Thysanura. By surface analysis, щети́на (ščetína, “bristle”) + хвост (xvost, “tail”) + -ка (-ka).
